Name: Great Living Chola Temples
Description: Three great temples built by the Chola dynasty: Brihadisvara at Thanjavur, Brihadisvara at Gangaikondacholapuram, and Airavatesvara at Darasuram.

Name: Mahabalipuram Monuments
Description: A collection of 7th and 8th century religious monuments. Famous for Shore Temple and rock-cut sculptures.
